digest.component_or_area: linting and quality gates for production source
propositions: Add a shrink-only complexity baseline enforcement that accepts bounded C901 debt while blocking new and increased violations in production Python code under src/rebar.

Create a three-stage complexity gate: (1) raw Ruff census exit 1 and (2) machine-readable Ruff JSON with --exit-zero exit 0 establish the current state, then (3) a wrapper exits 0 only when all findings are at or below recorded ceilings and no scanner/schema error exists.
Implement a guarded --update-stale maintenance mode that can only lower or remove stale debt ceilings, refusing any new or increased complexity debt while using atomic-write to persist JSON.

Normalize C901 findings to repository-relative POSIX path::qualified-symbol keys derived from Python AST, reject duplicates and schema violations, and track active/new/increased/stale counters as mutually exclusive per key.
Wire the complexity wrapper into make lint alongside existing Ruff and format checks, scoping complexity enforcement to production src/rebar only while other lints cover both src and tests.

Document the threshold 15, scope src/rebar, live census count, Ruff version, and wrapper check command in the maintenance runbook, identifying historical baseline numbers as dated observations rather than the gate contract.
